quotes.text: Clinicians select a target disease and associated findings, then construct the presentation from which the agent must infer the diagnosis.

parsed.rationale: Origin (clinician-authored cases grounded in PrimeKG/HPO and public case reports) and collection method (clinician authoring with LLM assistance and revision) are documented. No data licence or terms and no consent or IRB statement appear; the Apache-2.0 licence in the README covers code.
